title: RoboCode: Learning Reusable Action Primitives for Robot Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.32225v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent robot manipulation policies commonly predict continuous action chunks directly from observations, without explicitly modeling reusable structure in the action space. However, manipulation demonstrations often contain recurring short-horizon motion patterns that are shared across tasks. We introduce \textsc{RoboCode}, which learns these patterns through a shared soft-gated primitive action interface. Rather than assigning each action chunk to a single discrete code, \textsc{RoboCode} represents it as a soft composition of multiple learned primitives, providing a flexible intermediate representation of short-horizon actions. The primitive interface is learned from action chunks pooled across multiple tasks and then frozen while task-specific state encoders are trained to map current state inputs into the shared latent space. translated_title: RoboCode：为机器人操作学习可复用的动作基元
translated_abstract: 近期的机器人操作策略通常直接从观测预测连续的动作块，而没有显式地对动作空间中的可复用结构进行建模。然而，操作演示中往往包含跨任务共享的、重复出现的短时程运动模式。我们提出了RoboCode，它通过一个共享的软门控基元动作接口来学习这些模式。RoboCode并不将每个动作块分配给单一的离散编码，而是将其表示为多个已学习基元的软组合，从而为短时程动作提供一种灵活的中间表示。该基元接口从跨多个任务汇总的动作块中学习得到，随后被冻结，同时训练任务特定的状态编码器将当前状态输入映射到共享潜空间中。在五个ManiSkill操作任务上的实验回答了三个问题。首先，学习到的基元……
tldr: RoboCode通过共享的软门控基元动作接口，将机器人操作中的动作块表示为多个可复用基元的软组合，从而学习跨任务共享的短时程运动模式。
